findings.explanation: Ledger changes require two approvals including one from the Platform team, so merging without review and with only a Payments approval violates this.
findings.decisionTitle: Two approvals for ledger code changes
findings.decision: Pull requests that touch the ledger package need two approvals, one from the Platform team.
